draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Willow Collective's setup
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Glad things are going well — and yes, let's do that walkthrough whenever you're ready.

On your open ticket about SSO: SSO is available on the Team plan, and I'll make sure you get a proper answer there rather than guessing at the details here.

If it's useful, I can walk you through inviting your team on a short call this week — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add everyone at once.

Best,
Chidi
